Reefton · West Coast · New Zealand
Boxing club · Reefton, West Coast

Small town.
Big heart.
Real boxing.

Reefton Boxing Club is the West Coast’s boxing club — a registered charity coaching local kids and adults, and a club that punches well above its weight. Everyone is welcome.

Start training → Why Reefton
170 Buller Rd · Reefton
Registered charityReefton Boxing Gym Inc is a registered charity (CC61920) — run for the community, not for profit.
Youth firstCoaching young people is at the heart of the club — confidence, discipline and fitness that last a lifetime.
Golden GlovesCo-host of the South Island Golden Gloves — Reefton puts West Coast boxing on the map.
01
Why Reefton

More than a gym.

In a small town, a boxing club is more than a place to train. It’s where kids grow up strong, where neighbours become training partners, and where the whole Coast comes together.

🥊

Learn to box

Real coaching from people who know the sport — footwork, defence, combinations and conditioning, taught properly from day one.

🌱

Youth coaching

A charity with a mission: giving Reefton’s young people somewhere positive to be, and something to work towards.

🤝

Community club

Run by locals, for locals. Come along, meet the team, and see what a West Coast boxing club feels like.

02
Golden Gloves

Punching above our weight.

“A small town with a big fighting heart.”

Reefton co-hosts the South Island Golden Gloves — bringing one of New Zealand boxing’s great nights to the West Coast, and showing the country what Reefton can do.

It’s the same spirit that runs through every session at the club: turn up, work hard, look after each other — and be proud of where you’re from.
